During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attempted to [[Infiltration of unidentified Imperial planet|infiltrate]] this '''planet''' controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The mission was a failure, and the infiltration team was forced to retreat.
